subject: Penpot export breakpoint 01 — deterministic PNG probe
body: Run the deterministic export probe against the REAL currently focused Penpot page. Do not ask the model to choose tools. Directly call export_shape for shapeId=page, format=png, mode=shape. Return image_count, visual_source, visual_fallback_error, result content types, and every filePath diagnostic including requested path, parent writability, existence, file size, and MCP response summary.
